en.headline: Police appeal for information on 72-year-old woman missing in Tai Po
en.dek: So Sau-chun was last seen early yesterday on Yuen Shan Road; she is described as about 1.6 metres tall and was wearing black clothing.
body: Police are appealing for public help to find a 72-year-old woman who went missing in Tai Po.

So Sau-chun was last seen in the early hours of Friday on Yuen Shan Road. Her family reported her missing the same day. She is about 1.6 metres tall, weighs about 55 kilograms, has a medium build, a round face, yellow skin and short black hair.

She was last seen wearing a black jacket, black trousers and black-and-white sports shoes. Anyone with information is asked to call 3661 3113 or email rmpu-ntn-1@police.gov.hk, or contact any police station.

zh.headline: 大埔72歲女子失蹤 警方呼籲市民提供消息
zh.dek: 蘇秀珍昨日凌晨在完善路最後露面，身高約1.6米，身穿黑色外套及長褲。
body: 警方呼籲市民提供一名在大埔失蹤的72歲女子的消息。
蘇秀珍昨日凌晨在完善路最後露面後失蹤，家人同日報案。她身高約1.6米、體重約55公斤、中等身材、圓面型、黃皮膚及短黑髮。
最後露面時身穿黑色外套、黑色長褲及黑白色波鞋。任何人士如有消息或曾見過她，請致電3661 3113或電郵至rmpu-ntn-1@police.gov.hk聯絡新界北總區失蹤人口調查組，或與任何警署聯絡。
